themes.disagreements: Cough presence (090) is a weak signal compared to the strong signals seen in COPD (087, 088). CAP presence (081) primarily predicts the outcome rather than the treatment.
themes.interpretation: Features related to chronic and acute respiratory conditions. COPD presence and severity show strong, consistent signals for both treatment prediction and outcome prognosis.
themes.name: COPD and Respiratory Health

themes.disagreements: Coronary artery disease (089) shows negligible signal compared to the aggregate comorbidity count (082).
themes.interpretation: Broad measures of patient sickness. Total comorbidity count is a highly significant predictor of both treatment assignment and outcome.
themes.name: General Health and Comorbidity Burden

themes.disagreements: CMP results (084) strongly predict treatment but not the outcome, whereas CBC (083) and contrast concentration (086) provide little to no evidence for any role.
themes.interpretation: Qualitative and quantitative results from standard blood and imaging panels.
themes.name: Laboratory Diagnostics

themes.disagreements: Unlike the respiratory/comorbidity features, confusion presents as a signal of treatment effect heterogeneity rather than a main-effect confounder.
themes.interpretation: Assessment of current neurological state upon presentation.
themes.name: Acute Clinical Symptoms
